# Forus Freight

> Forus Freight Limited is a logistics and freight company registered in Zambia, providing road, air, and sea freight, customs brokerage, warehousing, and real-time shipment tracking across Zambia and the SADC region.

Forus Freight is based in Lusaka, Zambia (METROLUX PLAZA, Plot No. 401A/8 Kafure Road). Business hours are Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00 CAT.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://forusfl.co.zm/services): Same-day delivery, cross-border shipping, warehousing and storage, and bulk cargo transport.
- [Request a quote](https://forusfl.co.zm/quote): Get a free freight quote.
- [Track a shipment](https://forusfl.co.zm/tracking): Real-time shipment tracking by tracking number.

## Company

- [About](https://forusfl.co.zm/about): Company overview.
